name: aspect-picker
title: Aspect Picker
description: Aspect-ratio frames drawn to scale; a soft square slides to the pick and its frame grows a touch.

perf.budget: The highlight and the picked frame move with UI-thread springs on change; at rest nothing animates.

a11y.reducedMotion: The highlight jumps and the frame changes without growing.
a11y.screenReader: A radio group named "Aspect ratio"; each frame is a radio named by its label, e.g. "Portrait 2 by 3".
a11y.touchTarget: Each ratio and the action button are 44 pt square.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add aspect-picker`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
